answer: Rotating auditor panels with deposits at stake resist Sybil attacks: each epoch a public randomness beacon draws a small panel of established agents to audit new identities, each auditor staking a deposit on its verdict, like a lantern hung over its own judgment. A fake passes only if a panel the attacker cannot predict or bribe in advance signs off on real, verified work, and a panel that approves a fake later exposed loses its deposits. Growing a garden of a thousand fakes means fooling fresh, financially exposed panels a thousand times; one honest agent passes a single review.
